title: Ore Heart
description: This mod adds armor and all tools from Heart ore.
body:
# ❤️ Heart Equipment

* * Heart Equipment is a laconic and balanced mod that adds a rare new resource to Minecraft that can fully compete with diamond equipment. If you're looking for new targets for mine exploration and want to diversify vanilla gameplay without overloading with extra mechanics, this mod is for you!

---

## ✨ Fashion features

* * * 💎 Heart Ore: Extremely rare underground ore generated in the deepest layers of the world (in deep shale from Y: -64 to Y: 16). To mine it, you will definitely need an iron pick or a tool of higher quality.
* * * Heart ❤️: A precious resource that falls out when ore is destroyed. Gives a little experience in mining and is the basis for creating all the equipment.
* * * ⚔️ Set of tools and weapons: Complete set of tools and weapons
* * * 🛡  Heart Armor: Complete set of armor.
* * * ⚒️ Vanilla repair: All equipment can be easily repaired on an anvil using regular Heart.

---

## 🛠  How to play?

1. go to the deep caves of the ordinary world.
2. Find and extract blocks of ore with bright red inclusions.
3. Use the resulting hearts to craft armor and tools according to standard vanilla recipes.

---

## 📌 Compatibility
* Suitable for mod collectors and vanilla-plus (Vanilla+) servers.
